description: This file defines the 'SimpleCommandResponse' class, a final immutable Java class that represents a JSON-serializable response for commands with optional correlationId and payload fields. It includes methods for constructing instances, creating instances from JSON strings or objects, and for converting instances back to JSON.

classes.name: SimpleCommandResponse
classes.description: A final class representing a command response, capable of being serialized to and from JSON. It holds optional correlationId and payload fields and provides static factory methods for instantiation.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new SimpleCommandResponse with specified correlationId and payload.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a SimpleCommandResponse instance from a JSON string or JSON object.

methods.name: getCorrelationId
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the correlationId.

methods.name: getPayload
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the payload.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the SimpleCommandResponse instance to a JSON object.
